name: capture-mcp-server
description: Federal procurement and spending data capture
long_description: Capture MCP Server provides 34 federal procurement and spending tools through natural language queries. Seven reference and USASpending.gov tools work without a provider key; optional SAM.gov, Tango, and HigherGov keys enable the remaining provider and join tools.

tools.name: search_sam_entities
tools.description: Search for federal entities/businesses registered in SAM.gov

tools.name: get_sam_opportunities
tools.description: Fetch federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov

tools.name: get_sam_entity_details
tools.description: Get comprehensive details for a specific entity by UEI

tools.name: check_sam_exclusions
tools.description: Check if an entity is excluded from federal contracting

tools.name: get_usaspending_awards
tools.description: Get federal awards data for a specific agency

tools.name: get_usaspending_spending_by_category
tools.description: Get spending breakdown by award category

tools.name: get_usaspending_budgetary_resources
tools.description: Get budgetary resources and obligations for an agency

tools.name: search_usaspending_awards_by_recipient
tools.description: Search for federal awards by recipient name

tools.name: get_entity_and_awards
tools.description: Combine SAM entity data with USASpending award history

tools.name: get_opportunity_spending_context
tools.description: Link opportunities with historical spending context

tools.name: search_tango_contracts
tools.description: Search federal contracts through Tango's unified API

tools.name: search_tango_grants
tools.description: Search federal grants and financial assistance

tools.name: get_tango_vendor_profile
tools.description: Get comprehensive vendor profiles with history

tools.name: search_tango_opportunities
tools.description: Search federal contract opportunities with forecasts

tools.name: get_tango_spending_summary
tools.description: Get spending summaries and analytics

tools.name: lookup_reference_code
tools.description: Official FPDS descriptions for set-aside, extent-competed, award-type, solicitation-procedure, and competition codes (static, no API key)

tools.name: get_award_detail
tools.description: Full FPDS record for one award from USASpending: set-aside, extent competed, offers received - the verification primitive

tools.name: aggregate_contracts
tools.description: Aggregate USASpending contract awards by agency, sub-agency, recipient, NAICS, PSC, month, or set-aside with count or obligations metric

tools.name: search_highergov_forecasts
tools.description: Pull forecasts matching a HigherGov saved search with cursor pagination

tools.name: get_highergov_opportunity
tools.description: Get one HigherGov opportunity by ID, SAM notice ID, or URL

tools.name: search_highergov_contracts
tools.description: Search awarded contracts for recompete targeting by agency, NAICS, PSC, set-aside, PoP end dates, and value

tools.name: get_highergov_contract
tools.description: Full record for one contract by HigherGov contract ID or PIID

tools.name: search_highergov_people
tools.description: Search federal POCs by agency and role keywords

tools.name: get_highergov_person
tools.description: Full profile for one federal POC including verified email

tools.name: search_highergov_opportunities
tools.description: Search active opportunities by set-aside bundle, NAICS, PSC, agency, and dates without a saved search

tools.name: list_highergov_saved_searches
tools.description: List the saved searches available to the HigherGov API key

tools.name: get_opportunity_documents
tools.description: List solicitation documents and amendments for one opportunity with fetchable URLs

tools.name: search_tango_protests
tools.description: Search GAO bid protests by agency, protester, outcome, and dates for pre-bid risk scoring

tools.name: get_tango_protest
tools.description: Get one GAO bid protest record by case number

tools.name: search_tango_idvs
tools.description: Search IDIQ/BPA/FSS indefinite-delivery vehicles that issue task orders

tools.name: get_tango_idv_children
tools.description: Get child IDVs, task orders, and transactions under one IDV

tools.name: search_tango_vehicles
tools.description: Search the federal contract-vehicle catalog (GWACs, MAS, BPAs)

tools.name: search_tango_otas
tools.description: Search Other Transaction Authority (OTA) awards

tools.name: get_tango_entity_metrics
tools.description: Time-series obligations for one UEI bucketed by month, quarter, or year

SAM_GOV_API_KEY.title: SAM.gov API Key
SAM_GOV_API_KEY.description: Optional API key from sam.gov/data-services/API. Enables 6 additional tools: 4 SAM.gov tools (entities, opportunities, details, exclusions) + 2 Join tools (entity+awards, opportunity+context).

TANGO_API_KEY.title: Tango API Key
TANGO_API_KEY.description: Optional API key from tango.makegov.com. Enables 5 Tango tools: contracts, grants, vendor profiles, opportunities, and spending summaries.
